# Representation crosswalk — r0.5

Scientific scope is fixed before engineering representation.

| Scientific object | Exact required queries/semantics | Engineering alternatives |
|---|---|---|
| resolved state | owner-fixed finite AO-004 vocabulary | full, compact exact, or exact lineage |
| response role | owner-fixed type/domain/query/validity/consumer scope | materialized, structured exact, or exact lineage |
| covariance role | complete, named projected, or unavailable per role | resident exact or exact lineage after scope |
| seven SCI-VAL roles | PA/SA/SP/CU/NU/RU/FH semantics and dependency graph | seven records, grouped lossless, or seven-vector |
| numerical operator | exact scientific comparator and failure semantics | one preregistered conformance profile or typed unavailable |

No representation chooses a scientific option, changes a validity domain,
manufactures missing authority, or permits an unsupported query.
